div.head: Hl 13
div.ab: Gif man wæpn abregde þær mæn drincen ⁊ ðær man nan yfel ne deþ, scilling þan þe þæt flet age, ⁊ cyninge XII scll'.
Gif man wæpn abregde þær mæn drincen ⁊ ðær man nan yfel ne deþ, scilling þa[m] þe þæt flet age, ⁊ cyninge XII scƚƚ.
If a person should draw a weapon where men are drinking and no harm is done there, a shilling to him who owns that house, and 12 shillings to the king.
If, where men are drinking, a man draws his weapon, but no harm is done there, he shall pay a shilling to him who owns the house, and 12 shillings to the king.
If anyone draws a weapon where men are drinking, and yet no injury is done there, [he is to pay] a shilling to him who owns the house and 12 shillings to the king.
Wenn jemand eine Waffe zückt, wo Leute trinken und wo man nichts Übles thut, [zahle er 1] Schilling demjenigen, der das Haus besitzt, und dem Könige 12 Schll.;
If someone draws a weapon where people are drinking and where no harm is done, [let him pay 1] shilling to the one who owns the house, and 12 shillings to the king;
